verdict.rationale: vLLM is a local inference engine, and serving speech-to-text models on local hardware is a fair capability to ask of this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only text generation features (PagedAttention, batching, quantization, tool calling, OpenAI-compatible server). Nothing mentions audio input, transcription endpoints, or real-time dictation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
